verdict.rationale: The only on-topic first-party evidence is that code can 'also' be checked from the command line with `npx sv check`, which implies editor-side checking exists, and that Svelte supports .svelte.ts files. No language server or editor extension is explicitly documented. One community member reported IDE support 'has been an issue', which is general friction rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a Svelte language server or editor extension, evidence of accurate autocompletion in .svelte files, evidence of inline type errors in the editor, and independent hands-on corroboration that the integration works well.
